record_scope_reconstruction: Eight named automobile checkpoints reopened: Jartepa/Sarazm, Kushkent/Ura-Tube, Uchkurgan/Khavatag, Khavastabad/Zafarabad, Bekabad/Khashtyak, Pap/Navbunyod, Ravat/Ravot and Gulbahor/Ayvaj. Amuzang/Khoshadi is the ninth reported reopening but is a railway and is excluded from this road-only phase.

source_checks.finding: Original Foreign Ministry-based report identifies road pairings separately from the Amuzang railway; a malformed stray word in its list is not treated as another checkpoint.
Kabar independently reproduces the eight road names and one railway, resolving the road set.
